init.title: Charger, load balancer and schedule
init.description: Start/stop uses the cloud EVDriver account. The local charger connection reads meters only. The load balancer has a separate connection and is the only endpoint allowed to change group current. Confirm its role before enabling the schedule.

data.local_host: Load balancer IP address or URL
data.local_password: Load balancer password (blank keeps saved password)
data.local_is_balancer: I confirm the load balancer address is a GARO Entity Balance

data_description.local_verify_ssl: Leave disabled for GARO controllers with a self-signed certificate.
data_description.schedule_enabled: When enabled, the integration automatically writes the selected group-current limit every time the period changes.
data_description.schedule_default_limit: Use only a value verified for the electrical installation. This changes GaroConnectionGroupMaxCurrent.
data_description.schedule_peak_limit: Lower group-current limit used during the selected peak period.

error.local_incomplete: Check addresses and credentials. Charger and balancer must have different addresses. The schedule requires an enabled, confirmed load balancer.
